initial.title: [v0.92.1][CORP-D] Corporate diligence acceptance
initial.goal: Produce one corporate diligence acceptance record bound to the exact diligence index.
initial.required_outcome: One corporate diligence acceptance record binds the exact diligence index to live CORP-A, CORP-B, and CORP-C dispositions, while counsel-controlled judgments remain bounded receipts and private advice stays outside Git.
authority_boundary: Issue #498 owns only the CORP-D corporate diligence acceptance decision.
Issue #482 owns CORP-A critical-asset schedule truth.
Issue #497 owns CORP-C operational-control transfer truth and must be live merged and ancestral before CORP-D can accept diligence.
Sprint umbrella #532 coordinates child dispositions only and does not absorb child implementation.
Counsel-controlled judgments are recorded only as bounded public or redacted receipts; private legal advice is never committed.
No provider, account, billing, credential, DNS, certificate, CI, Terraform, deployment, or production mutation is authorized by #498.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue work on main.
Use the bound FastWork issue worktree for execution.
Preserve typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle authority.
Do not print, copy, commit, or expose secrets, credentials, private legal advice, private diligence material, account identifiers, or recovery factors.
Treat typed finish and cleanup receipts as audit-only; live merged/ancestral prerequisite truth is the execution gate.
Stop before any external mutation unless the operator explicitly authorizes the exact operation in a separate typed lane.
initial.task_boundary: Issue completion is exactly one diligence acceptance decision; prerequisite and counsel receipts are inputs to that decision.
deliverables: CORP-A through CORP-C prerequisite census with blocker dispositions
Counsel-boundary receipt register containing only public or redacted references
Validation evidence for diligence index, prerequisite census, counsel boundary, acceptance readback, redaction, and diff hygiene
Truthful SRP/SOR records and exact-head pre-publication review
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every CORP-A-C blocker has a disposition.
AC-2: Counsel-controlled judgments are recorded only as bounded receipts.
AC-3: Corporate acceptance binds the exact diligence index.
AC-4: CORP-A #482, CORP-B #483, and CORP-C #497 are live merged into main and ancestral to the #498 execution base before acceptance is recorded.
AC-5: No private advice, credentials, account identifiers, recovery factors, or secret material is committed.
dependencies: CORP-A #482 live merged and ancestral to #498 execution base
CORP-B #483 live merged and ancestral to #498 execution base
CORP-C #497 live merged and ancestral to #498 execution base; current execution must fail closed while #497 remains open or non-ancestral
Sprint 4 umbrella #532 remains open until both #497 and #498 are merged and ancestral
non_goals: Mutating provider, billing, credentials, DNS, certificates, CI, Terraform, deployment, or production state
initial.plan_summary: Initialize CORP-D, bind a FastWork execution lane, fail closed until CORP-A/B/C are live merged and ancestral, produce a redacted diligence index and acceptance record, validate the issue-owned evidence, obtain exact-head review, and publish one closing PR.

steps.action: Confirm #482, #483, and #497 live issue/PR merge state and ancestry against the #498 execution base.
Build the exact diligence index and prerequisite blocker census without copying private diligence or legal advice.
Record counsel-controlled judgments only as bounded public or redacted receipt references.
Write the corporate diligence acceptance record only if every prerequisite blocker is dispositioned and live merged/ancestral.
Run all planned PVF lanes, obtain exact-head review, publish a closing PR for #498, and update Sprint 4 child disposition truth.

invariants: Corporate diligence acceptance cannot be recorded while any CORP-A-C prerequisite is open, unmerged, non-ancestral, or has an unresolved blocker.
Counsel-controlled judgment content is never committed; only bounded public or redacted receipt references are allowed.
The diligence index is the denominator for the acceptance record.
The issue does not mutate external control planes or absorb CORP-C/Sprint 4 work.
All lifecycle state is generated through typed C-SDLC v2 tools.
risks: CORP-C #497 may remain open, non-closing, or non-ancestral, which blocks CORP-D acceptance.
A diligence record could overstate legal or corporate acceptance if counsel receipts are missing or private.
A private diligence detail, account identifier, recovery factor, or credential could accidentally enter retained evidence.
Sprint umbrella truth could drift if #498 readiness is confused with terminal child completion.
stop_conditions: An unresolved CORP-A-C blocker lacks disposition.
CORP-C #497 is not live merged into main and ancestral to the #498 execution base.
Private advice, private diligence material, account identifiers, recovery factors, credentials, or secrets would enter Git.
A required action would mutate external provider, account, billing, credential, DNS, certificate, CI, Terraform, deployment, or production state without explicit operator authorization.
Exact-head review finds unresolved actionable issues.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove the #498 typed cards, design, diagram, dependency gates, scope, COTS-free posture, budgets, PVF lanes, and Sprint 4 umbrella update evidence are structurally ready.
Fail closed unless CORP-A #482, CORP-B #483, and CORP-C #497 are live merged into main and ancestral to the #498 execution base.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Run at execution start; it must fail closed while #497 is not live merged and ancestral.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate the exact diligence index denominator and one-to-one mapping into the acceptance record.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Run after the diligence index and acceptance record exist.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate that counsel-controlled judgments are represented only by bounded public or redacted receipts and no private advice is committed.
Validate that corporate diligence acceptance binds the exact diligence index and refuses acceptance when prerequisites remain unresolved.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Run after the acceptance record exists.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Verify whitespace and patch hygiene for #498 issue-owned changes.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on unresolved prerequisite blockers, non-ancestral dependency merges, private advice or credential exposure, external mutation without explicit operator authorization, incomplete diligence index binding, or unresolved exact-head review findings.
review_prompts: Does #498 refuse acceptance while CORP-C #497 remains open, non-closing, or non-ancestral?
Does the diligence index cover every CORP-A through CORP-C blocker/disposition input without inventing legal conclusions?
Are counsel-controlled judgments represented only as bounded public or redacted receipts?
Does the acceptance record bind the exact diligence index and avoid private/secret material?
Does Sprint 4 umbrella truth distinguish #498 readiness from #498 terminal completion?
initial.review_scope: Issue #498 cards, design, diagram, prepared validators, diligence evidence under docs/operations/corporate/diligence and docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/corporate/corp-d, and Sprint 4 umbrella disposition evidence only.
